newsitem.title: USA: Pogo Producing wins bids for offshore blocks.
newsitem.headline: Pogo Producing wins bids for offshore blocks.

text.p: Pogo Producing Co said Wednesday that the company, along with several industry partners, won bids for two tracts at the federal oil and gas lease sale.

The total bonus for the lease blocks on which the company and its partners were high bidders was $925,160, and Pogo's net share of the two high bids totaled $462,580, the company said. Pogo holds a 50 percent interest in each block.
Pogo and its partners had submitted bids for six tracts. The winning bids cover areas on the western part of the Outer Continental Shelf off the Texas shoreline.
